claim: For the real plane \(X=(\mathbb R^2,\|\cdot\|_{2,1})\), where \(\|(u,v)\|_{2,1}=\sqrt{u^2+v^2}\) when \(uv\ge 0\) and \(\|(u,v)\|_{2,1}=|u|+|v|\) when \(uv\le 0\), the Ptolemy constant is exactly \(C_{\mathrm{Pt}}(X)=\sqrt 2\).
integrity: The equality has a self-contained upper bound and exact attaining configuration. Literature comparisons distinguish inspected implications from an access residual.
scientific_limitations: The proof is complete for the stated real two-dimensional norm. The originality comparison has residual access risk because the full text of Zuo (2015), DOI 10.12386/A2015sxxb0033, was not obtained; its abstract alone does not establish coverage.
title: Exact Ptolemy constant of the \(\ell_2-\ell_1\) plane
